universe.label: Universe
universe.tooltip: The stocks the strategy looks at: India's 750 largest companies by market value.
universe.formula: Ranked by market capitalisation from exchange data. Refreshed at each weekly review.

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.tooltip: The single call for a stock: BUY, HOLD, EXIT or REJECT. For a stock you do not own, HOLD and EXIT both mean it is not a buy.
verdict.formula: REJECT if any governance point is Bad. Otherwise from the score: 3 of 3 is BUY (only when the required governance points are assessed), 2 of 3 is HOLD, 0 or 1 is EXIT. Below the 200 DMA while behind the Nifty 500 is also EXIT.

verdict_buy.label: Buy
verdict_buy.tooltip: All three momentum rules are met and governance passed, so new money may go in.
verdict_buy.formula: Score 3 of 3, no Bad governance grade, and governance points 4, 5 and 18 assessed.

verdict_hold.label: Hold
verdict_hold.tooltip: Keep it if you own it, but add nothing. If you do not own it, it is not a buy.
verdict_hold.formula: Score 2 of 3. Also shown for 3 of 3 when a required governance point is not assessed, with the reason.

verdict_reject.label: Rejected
verdict_reject.tooltip: Governance failed, so the stock is out however strong its price is.
verdict_reject.formula: At least one of the 18 governance points is graded Bad.

score.label: Score
score.tooltip: How many of the three momentum rules the stock meets today.
score.formula: Price at its all-time high, profit at its high, and 52-week return ahead of both indexes. Each is met or not met. A rule that could not be checked is shown as not assessed and does not count as met.

run.label: Run date
run.tooltip: The date of the scan run these results come from.
run.formula: Prices and profits are as of that day's close. Every row in the list shows the run date selected above the table.

rank.label: Rank
rank.tooltip: Position by 52-week return among the stocks in the chosen index that pass the first two momentum checks. 1 is the strongest. Worked out again on every scan. Stocks that do not qualify show a dash.
rank.formula: The first two momentum checks are price at its all-time high and profit at its high. Stocks that pass both are ordered by 52-week return, highest first, within the index chosen in the Indices drop-down.

ret52.label: 52-week return
ret52.tooltip: How much the price rose or fell over the last 52 weeks.
ret52.formula: Closing price today divided by the closing price 52 weeks ago, minus 1. Adjusted for splits and bonuses.

alpha_n.label: Alpha vs Nifty 500
alpha_n.tooltip: How far the stock's 52-week return is ahead of, or behind, the Nifty 500.
alpha_n.formula: Stock 52-week return minus Nifty 500 52-week return, in percentage points. Exchange index data.

alpha_s.label: Alpha vs sector
alpha_s.tooltip: How far the stock's 52-week return is ahead of, or behind, its own sector index.
alpha_s.formula: Stock 52-week return minus the 52-week return of the sector index the stock is mapped to, in percentage points. Blank when the index data is missing.

below_ath.label: Below all-time high
below_ath.tooltip: How far the latest close is under the highest close on record.
below_ath.explanation: (All-time high close minus latest close) divided by all-time high close. Within 2% counts as at the high.

pat_chg.label: Adjusted profit change
pat_chg.tooltip: Change in the last twelve months of profit after tax against the twelve months before, with one-off items taken out.
pat_chg.formula: Last twelve months profit after tax minus exceptional items (land sales, stake sales), compared with the same figure a year earlier. Company financials.

gov.label: Governance
gov.tooltip: How many of the 18 governance points have evidence, and the worst grade among them.
gov.formula: Each point is graded Good, Neutral or Bad from filings and company financials. Points without evidence are Not assessed.

gov_grade.label: Governance grade
gov_grade.tooltip: The grade for one governance point.
gov_grade.formula: Good: no concern found. Neutral: some concern, not disqualifying. Bad: disqualifying, which rejects the stock. Not assessed: no evidence yet.

gov_required.label: Required for buy
gov_required.tooltip: Debt, pledged shares and exceptional items must be assessed before a buy is allowed.
gov_required.formula: Points 4, 5 and 18. While any of them is Not assessed the verdict cannot be BUY, and the screen says why.

not_assessed.label: Not assessed
not_assessed.tooltip: The data needed to grade this point or check this rule is missing. It is never treated as good.
not_assessed.formula: Shown in words wherever the data is missing. Not assessed governance points do not count as passed; a rule that could not be checked does not count as met.

reason.label: Verdict reason
reason.tooltip: A one-line reason for the verdict. Hover to read the full text.
reason.formula: Chosen by the rules in order: governance Bad, exit trigger, missing data that blocks a buy, then the first rule not met.

crit_ath.label: Price at all-time high
crit_ath.tooltip: Whether the stock is trading at the highest price it has ever closed at.
crit_ath.formula: Latest close within 2% of the all-time high close. The tolerance is 2%.

crit_pat.label: Profit at its high
crit_pat.tooltip: Whether the last twelve months of profit after tax are the highest in the data window, with one-offs removed.
crit_pat.formula: Last twelve months profit after tax minus exceptional items, compared with every earlier last-twelve-months figure in the data window (about 13 quarters and 12 years). It is the highest within the data window, not lifetime.

crit_alpha.label: Ahead of both indexes
crit_alpha.tooltip: Whether the 52-week return beats both the Nifty 500 and the stock's own sector index.
crit_alpha.formula: Stock 52-week return greater than the Nifty 500 return and greater than the sector index return. Ahead of only one does not count.

data_window.label: Data window
data_window.tooltip: The stretch of history the profit and price checks can see.
data_window.formula: About 13 quarters of quarterly profit and 12 years of yearly profit. Highs are highs within this window.

exchange_index.label: Exchange index data
exchange_index.tooltip: Index levels published by the exchange, used for the Nifty 500 and sector comparisons.
exchange_index.formula: Daily index closes stored in our own database.

one_offs.label: One-off items
one_offs.tooltip: Profit that will not repeat, such as a property sale or the sale of a stake.
one_offs.formula: Exceptional items reported by the company are subtracted from profit after tax before the high is tested.

sma200.label: 200 DMA
sma200.tooltip: The simple average of the last 200 daily closing prices. It is the long-term trend line, and the exit line is worked out from it.
sma200.explanation: Simple moving average of the last 200 daily closes: their sum divided by 200. It stays 200 days on weekly and monthly charts.

exit_rule_ema.label: Moving-average exit
exit_rule_ema.tooltip: A hard exit when the price is below its 200 DMA and the stock is behind the Nifty 500.
exit_rule_ema.formula: Both must be true: latest close under the 200 DMA, and 52-week return under the Nifty 500 return.

exit_trigger.label: Exit trigger
exit_trigger.tooltip: A rule that says to exit a holding, in plain words.
exit_trigger.formula: Score of 1 of 3 or lower, or below the 200 DMA while behind the Nifty 500.

analyst_stance.label: Analyst stance (context)
analyst_stance.tooltip: The older six-pillar read of the company: Constructive, Mixed or Cautious.
analyst_stance.explanation: From the earlier scorecard on filings and financials. It is context and no longer drives ranking.

trade_risk.label: Trade risk
trade_risk.tooltip: The share of the price you would lose if the stock fell to your exit.
trade_risk.formula: (Buy price minus exit price) divided by buy price.

risk_per_position.label: Risk per position
risk_per_position.tooltip: The most you are willing to lose on one stock, as a share of the chosen base.
risk_per_position.formula: 18% total loss budget divided by 15 stocks is 1.2%.

exit_price.label: Exit price
exit_price.tooltip: The price you set before buying, to sell at if the stock falls to it. Position sizing uses it.
exit_price.formula: Suggested value: the lower of the 200 DMA and 80% of the buy price. The suggestion stays between 5% and 30% below the buy price. A price you type replaces it.

alloc.label: Allocation
alloc.tooltip: How much of the base goes into this stock.
alloc.formula: Risk per position divided by the percentage fall from buy price to exit. Buy at 100 with exit at 80 is a 20% fall, so 1.2% / 20% = 6%.

allocation_cap.label: Largest allocation
allocation_cap.tooltip: A ceiling on any one position, as a share of Net Asset Value.
allocation_cap.formula: Default 15%. A very tight exit would otherwise ask for a huge position.

investment_value.label: Investment Value
investment_value.tooltip: The total cost of what is invested in your portfolio today.
investment_value.formula: Sum of quantity times average cost over your holdings. You type it.

notional_pnl.label: Notional profit or loss
notional_pnl.tooltip: The gain or loss on paper on your holdings, not yet sold.
notional_pnl.formula: Current market value of holdings minus Investment Value. Enter a negative number for a loss.

nav.label: Net Asset Value
nav.tooltip: What your portfolio is worth today.
nav.formula: Investment Value plus notional profit, or minus notional loss. Type it directly and the profit or loss updates to match.

cash_available.label: Cash available
cash_available.tooltip: Money you can put into the new stock now.
cash_available.formula: Optional. The position is reduced if the amount asked for is more than this.

holdings_count.label: Stocks you hold
holdings_count.tooltip: How many stocks are in your portfolio now.
holdings_count.formula: Optional. Used only to warn when the 1.2% rule's assumption of 15 stocks is exceeded.

average_cost.label: Average cost
average_cost.tooltip: What you paid per share on average for the shares you already hold.
average_cost.formula: Total cost divided by quantity. Used to stop advice to add when the price is below it.

size_against.label: Size against
size_against.tooltip: Which figure the risk percentage is applied to.
size_against.formula: Net Asset Value (default): risk budget is 1.2% of what the portfolio is worth today. Investment Value: 1.2% of what was put in.

risk_budget.label: Risk budget
risk_budget.tooltip: The rupees you are willing to lose on this stock.
risk_budget.formula: Risk per position times the chosen base.

add_hold_trim.label: Add, Hold or Trim
add_hold_trim.tooltip: What the target size means for shares you already own.
add_hold_trim.formula: Target quantity minus quantity held. Never advises adding when the price is below your average cost.

rank_chg.label: Rank Change
rank_chg.tooltip: Places moved since the previous scan of this index (the run date is shown). Up means a better rank. New means it was not ranked in the previous scan. A stock can move only because others moved. A rank change never changes the verdict.
rank_chg.formula: Rank in the previous completed scan of the same index minus rank in this scan. Scans run on market days only, so the previous scan is not always the previous calendar day.

held.label: You hold
held.tooltip: Marks stocks that are in the holdings you loaded this session.
held.formula: Matches symbols from your holdings. Not stored after the session.

not_in_universe.label: Not in universe
not_in_universe.tooltip: The stock is not in the top 750, so only what can be computed is tested.
not_in_universe.formula: Price, 200 DMA and 52-week return can be computed; profit history, sector index and governance may not be.

change_entry.label: Change since entry
change_entry.tooltip: How much the price has moved since your average cost.
change_entry.formula: (Last price minus average price) divided by average price.

exit_watch.label: Exit watch
exit_watch.tooltip: Holdings currently triggering an exit rule.
exit_watch.formula: Count of loaded holdings with at least one exit trigger.
